files.description: Main ExportBuilders article from Zendesk help center — the registered (b)(10) EHI export documentation. Contains detailed step-by-step instructions for using the ExportBuilder tool to generate CSV, TXT, XLS, and XML export files. Describes field selection, filtering, formatting options, value mapping, sub-exports, and saved format management. Does NOT contain a data dictionary or field listing.
Zendesk section index page for ExportBuilder. Contains only one article (the ExportBuilders main article).

HMIS Data Export article — describes the separate HMIS CSV export feature for generating HUD-compliant zipped CSV files. Covers export types (Full, HIC, RHY, Full+), program/CoC selection, date ranges, service type mappings, and upload workflows. The Full+ export type includes FormBuilder custom form data as additional CSV files and a ServicesOther.csv with service contact details.

Mandatory Disclosures PDF (updated Jan 16, 2025, 7 pages). Contains the official (b)(10) EHI export description: ExportBuilder tool for single or multiple patient export in CSV, XLS, or XML format. Also covers all other certified criteria with cost/fee information. Key finding: the (b)(10) entry states 'No cost or fees' for EHI export.

Costs and Limitations PDF (4 pages, from 2020). Original 2015 Edition certification costs and limitations. Covers CPOE, demographics, problem list, e-prescribing, clinical reconciliation, transitions of care, CQMs. Does not include (b)(10) as this predates Cures Act requirements.

FHIR API documentation site (static HTML capture). This is the (g)(10) standardized API documentation, NOT the (b)(10) export. Documents FHIR R4 with US Core STU 6.1.0 and USCDI v3. Covers standard resources: AllergyIntolerance, CarePlan, Condition, Coverage, Device, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference, Goal, Location, Medication, MedicationDispense, MedicationRequest, Observation, Organization, Patient, Practitioner, Provenance, ServiceRequest, Specimen. Page is lazy-loaded (Postman-style) so the static HTML capture is partial.
